description: This file is a PHP script for rendering the detail view of a PriceBook in the vtiger CRM system. It initializes the view, retrieves record info, checks permissions, assigns variables for the Smarty template, manages related lists, and handles navigation and custom links.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Represents a CRM entity with methods to retrieve and manipulate record data.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class customized for vtiger CRM.

methods.description: Static method to get an instance of a CRMEntity for a specific module.

methods.description: Retrieves entity information for a given record ID and module.

methods.description: Assigns variables to the Smarty template.
